name: kcat/openal-soft
description: Software implementation of the OpenAL 3D audio API providing distance attenuation, Doppler shift, directional emitters, environmental reverb via EFX, and cross-platform support as the standard open-source 3D audio API.
score_rationale: The canonical open-source implementation of the OpenAL standard with 2.6k stars, actively maintained through January 2026, and the go-to LGPL alternative to proprietary audio SDKs.
summary: Standard OpenAL software implementation for 3D game audio
